The '''RMD-20 "Eye in the Sky" Series Monitoring Droid''' was a cheap, small droid that could follow a target, patrol an area, or be guided by commands sent to its built-in [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. It was spherical with cameras arranged around it. It had no advanced sensors, and was basically a floating audio and visual transmitter. It was frequently used by civilians, but some cheaper police and military units would also field them.<ref name="A&E">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>

It could transmit audio and visual feeds to a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] or [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] on over a dozen modulated frequencies. The droid could be programmed with over 20 different flight patterns. The unit's [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] had to be recharged every five hours. Although the unit had a 10 kilometer range, it could only transmit feeds within 100 meters.

It could reach a speed of 130 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|km/h]] and an altitude of 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].
